Glucose.clinical_reason: Normal fasting: 70-99 mg/dL; 2h OGTT impaired: 140-199 mg/dL; Diabetic: >=200 mg/dL. Zero is biologically impossible in living patients.

BloodPressure.clinical_reason: Normal: <80 mm Hg; Stage 1 hypertension: 80-89 mm Hg; Stage 2: >=90 mm Hg. Zero indicates absent circulatory pressure (measurement omission).

SkinThickness.clinical_reason: Typical female adult range: 10-35 mm. Zero represents unrecorded or omitted caliper measurement.

Insulin.clinical_reason: Normal 2h post-load: 16-166 uU/mL. Zero is highly prevalent in the Pima dataset (approx 48%) due to omitted assay tests.

BMI.clinical_reason: Normal: 18.5-24.9 kg/m^2; Overweight: 25.0-29.9 kg/m^2; Obese: >=30.0 kg/m^2. Zero represents unrecorded patient stature/weight.
